title: Chapter 193: Getting Interesting
html:
Cassette recorders had flourished in the eighties and nineties but faded into obsolescence with the rise of the internet. To preserve the room’s period atmosphere, Tian Teng Medical School had filled it with antiques, most notably the recorder and an old-fashioned flashlight.

Chen Ge was reminded of a horror flick he had seen a long time ago. The recorder would play on its own every midnight, and those who heard it would die a horrible death.

Is this merely a prop?Ignoring the “corpse” slumped across the desk, Chen Ge approached the bookshelf. When he came within a meter of the recorder, its play button depressed by itself.

A sensor? No, someone is probably operating it remotely.Chen Ge glanced back. The corpse’s face remained buried in its arms. Far more interested in the recorder, he listened as the tape began to turn. After a burst of static, a middle-aged man’s voice emerged.

“Please, forgive me! I’m begging you!” The man pleaded as though death itself would be a mercy. Wet sounds of cutting and tearing followed his screams. The recording was brutally explicit, conjuring images of snapping bone, rending flesh, and merciless torture.

“Tian Teng probably wouldn’t use this for normal visitors.”

The corpse on the desk twitched at his words. Chen Ge’s guess was close to the truth: the staff had replaced the tape at the last moment specifically for him. He had grown accustomed to fear and dread, but graphic cruelty could still unsettle him. In that respect, he remained an ordinary person.

“It’s still going? Is this supposed to be the background music?” Expecting clues, Chen Ge listened patiently. A full minute passed, yet the victim continued screaming through his torture and begging for mercy.

“He should have lost consciousness from blood loss by now. How is he still this energetic after a minute of fatal injuries? Still, the voice actor is excellent. He created a frightening atmosphere through sound alone.” At last, the man’s voice weakened as the narrative revealed the punishment for his crimes.

Chen Ge then realized that the victim on the tape was the director of Tian Teng Medical School, a man who would do anything for money.

“Who would have expected such a simple moral—good is rewarded, and evil punished?” Near the tape’s end, the director confessed his crimes and used his final breath to beg his tormentors not to harm his daughter.

Then came the twist. As he pleaded for her safety, a door opened on the recording. A woman screamed, and the director shouted, “Zhenzhen, run!”

The recording ended. Chen Ge was unsure what to make of the story. The director was plainly guilty, while his daughter was probably innocent. More importantly, she had entered while the monsters tortured her father, suggesting she suffered the same fate.

Every mannequin bears the name Xu Zhenzhen. What does it mean?

Tian Teng Medical School was famous among Haunted House enthusiasts, and professionals had designed every scene. In the highest-difficulty version of such a major traveling attraction, the repeated name had to matter.

Are all these employees playing fake ghosts merely to conceal a real one?

The “female corpse” at the entrance, the dismembered mannequins, and Xu Zhenzhen’s name repeated throughout the attraction finally revealed the designers’ intention.

No matter how convincing the makeup, visitors know the actors are human. The designers therefore created a “real ghost” whose presence seems to follow everyone through the attraction. Xu Zhenzhen fills that role.

The concept was creative and gave Chen Ge considerable inspiration. You went to all this trouble to suggest a real ghost? In that case, I’ll give you one.

As the tape neared its end, Chen Ge pressed the eject button. His back was to the “corpse,” hiding what he did.

Recorders like this aren’t sold anymore. I might find one at a flea market if I’m lucky, but since there’s one here, I may as well test my tape.

He inserted his tape into the recorder and pressed play. The tape started to roll, but there was no sound.

An empty tape?

Chen Ge waited.

He wandered around the room as though admiring the décor.

After the Third Sick Hall, visiting Tian Teng Medical School felt like a vacation. Chen Ge had not been this relaxed in a long time. A Haunted House truly is a wonderful place to relieve stress. I should change our slogan when I get home.

During his stroll, he picked up a yellowed newspaper. A quick examination showed it was genuine and several years old.

“Xing Hai Morning News?” Intrigued, Chen Ge read that four years earlier, a woman named Xu Zhenzhen had taken her own life in an abandoned hospital. The hospital had once belonged to her father, who had committed suicide in his office ten years before her death.

Two victims had died in the same place years apart. The mysterious pair of suicides had shaken Xing Hai. A medical examiner confirmed that Xu Zhenzhen killed herself, yet distinct red handprints appeared on her body after death.

Public attention eventually moved on, as did the police, and the case was closed.

The victim was Xu Zhenzhen. So this is Tian Teng Medical School’s hidden secret.

Chen Ge lowered the newspaper. Most visitors would rush through screaming and miss such details. Only the brave would search carefully, and discovering that the attraction drew from a real event would crack their defenses, seed doubt, and deepen their fear.

Tian Teng Medical School’s design was nearly flawless, but even professionals with more than a decade of experience had never anticipated a visitor like Chen Ge.

This Haunted House really is interesting.Chen Ge recalled the map from the security booth. He had already explored two-thirds of the attraction and was nearing the exit.
